tools.name: Arcade_ListApps
tools.description: See the apps the current caller can act on and whether they are connected. Returns each app's id, name, connected state, and (when connected) the account it is connected as. Call this to answer "what apps do I have?" or when the caller's connection state may have changed since the session started.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_CheckSpreadsheetAccess
tools.description: Check whether this app can already read each of several spreadsheets, in one batched pre-flight call, before attempting to read them. Use this when the user references multiple spreadsheets so any that are not yet accessible can be granted together in a single picker step, instead of hitting a separate access error and grant prompt for each one. Each input may be a bare file id or a full Google Sheets/Drive URL. Returns ``spreadsheets`` (a per-id list with ``accessible``, the ``title`` and ``mim

params.name: spreadsheets
params.description: The spreadsheets to check access for, each given as a bare spreadsheet id or a full Google Sheets/Drive URL (the id is extracted from the URL). Provide at most 50 per call; split larger lists across m

tools.name: GoogleSheets_CommentOnSpreadsheet
tools.description: Create a comment on a spreadsheet, edit a comment's body, or resolve/reopen it. Comments are created at the file level: the Drive API cannot anchor a NEW Sheets comment to a specific cell or range. Cell/range-anchored comments made in the Sheets UI are still readable via list_spreadsheet_comments (which returns their anchor). Editing a comment's body is allowed only for the comment's author.

params.name: status
params.description: Resolve or reopen an existing comment (requires comment_id). Implemented as a reply with an action. Omit to create or edit instead.

params.name: content
params.description: The comment text. Required when creating. When editing an existing comment (comment_id set, no status) this replaces the body (author-only). When a status is set, this is the optional text of the reso

params.name: comment_id
params.description: Omit to CREATE a new comment. Provide an existing comment id to edit it (pass content) or to resolve/reopen it (pass status).

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: The id of the spreadsheet to comment on.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_CreateOrEditSpreadsheet
tools.description: Create a new spreadsheet or batch-edit an existing one. Omit `spreadsheet_id` to create; provide it to edit. All writes flow through `requests[]` — typed operations like updateCells, addSheet, sortRange, addConditionalFormatRule, autoResizeDimensions, and more. For updateCells use ExtendedValue with an explicit type field (stringValue, numberValue, boolValue, formulaValue). By default, build clean, professional-looking tables with restrained, consistent formatting and plain-text tab names/header

params.name: title
params.description: Title for a newly created spreadsheet. Ignored when spreadsheet_id is provided. Defaults to 'Untitled spreadsheet'.

params.name: requests
params.description: A list of Google Sheets `spreadsheets.batchUpdate` request objects. Each object must have exactly one key naming the operation. FIELDS MASK: updateCells, repeatCell, updateSheetProperties, and updateD

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: ID of an existing spreadsheet to edit. Omit to create a new spreadsheet.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_DeleteComment
tools.description: Delete a comment from a spreadsheet. Only the comment's author can delete it (enforced by Google Drive); deleting marks the whole thread (the comment and its replies) as deleted.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: The id of the comment to delete.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: The id of the spreadsheet the comment belongs to.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_GenerateGoogleFilePickerUrl
tools.description: Generate a URL where the user can grant this app access to spreadsheets. Opens Google's first-party Drive picker, filtered to Google Sheets, where the user browses and selects which spreadsheets to share with this application — it is not a sign-in or credential prompt. Use this when a prior tool reported that a file was not found or access was denied, and the user expects the file to exist. After the user completes the picker flow, retry the prior operation.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_GetSpreadsheetEditHistory
tools.description: Report who edited a spreadsheet and when, from Google Drive revisions. Reports the "who" and "when" only — not which cells changed, and it can't revert. 'summary' (default) answers "who last edited this and when" (read from the file's head, so always accurate), plus per-window aggregates (revisions read, contributors, first edit) and a preview of recent edits — computed over a bounded window of history per call. These aggregates describe the whole history only when `is_incomplete` is false; it i

params.name: mode
params.description: 'summary' (default): the latest edit, plus per-window aggregates (revisions read, contributors, first edit) that cover the whole history only when is_incomplete is false, and a preview of recent edits

params.name: limit
params.description: Max revisions per page in 'list' mode. Between 1 and 50. Defaults to 20. Ignored in 'summary' mode.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: The id of the spreadsheet to get the edit history for.

params.name: pagination_token
params.description: Token from a previous response's pagination_token, to continue reading more history. Works in both modes.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_InspectSpreadsheet
tools.description: Inspect a Google Sheets spreadsheet's structure or read a range of cells. Use the default 'structure' mode to understand a workbook cheaply before reading. Switch to 'read' mode to pull a range as a grid of rows, optionally with per-cell annotations and a rendered markdown/csv/tsv export. In 'read' mode the response's per-tab 'sheets' block reports only tab identity and the allocated grid; its scan-derived fields (used_range, populated_cell_count, formula_cell_count, first_row, table_regions) ar

params.name: mode
params.description: What to return. 'structure' (default) gives a cheap workbook overview: every tab's ids, allocated grid, frozen panes, merges, charts, protected ranges, conditional-format counts, real used range, firs

params.name: a1_range
params.description: Read mode only: the range of cells to pull, in A1 notation (e.g. 'A1:F100'), WITHIN the selected tab — the tab is chosen by sheet_id/sheet_title, and any sheet prefix here (e.g. 'Other!A1:B2') is igno

params.name: max_rows
params.description: Read mode only: maximum rows to return. Sets truncated=True when the range has more rows; pass the returned next_range as a1_range to page. When filtering, this bounds the rows SCANNED per page (match

params.name: sheet_id
params.description: Read mode only: select the tab by its numeric sheetId. Mutually exclusive with sheet_title. Defaults to the first tab when both are omitted.

params.name: export_as
params.description:
Read mode only: also render the returned values as text. Omit to return structured values only. csv/tsv are lossless; markdown is display-oriented (in-cell newlines become
, pipes are escaped).

params.name: max_length
params.description: Read mode only: cap each returned cell string at this many characters. A longer cell becomes '<first chars>…(+N chars)' (the suffix is not counted; N = hidden chars). Pass 0 for full, untruncated stri

params.name: annotations
params.description: Read mode only: per-cell extras to include — pass only the kinds you need (e.g. ['formulas','notes']); each extra kind adds payload. Omit or leave empty to return values only (cheaper). Returned spars

params.name: sheet_title
params.description: Read mode only: select the tab by name. Mutually exclusive with sheet_id. Defaults to the first tab when both are omitted.

params.name: value_render
params.description: Read mode only: 'formatted' (default) returns display strings like '$1,234.50'; 'unformatted' returns raw values suitable for math.

params.name: filter_combine
params.description: Read mode only: how to combine multiple filter_conditions — a single top-level 'and'/'or' applied to all conditions (no nested grouping or mixed and/or). Defaults to 'and'.

params.name: select_columns
params.description: Read mode only: return only these columns, by spreadsheet column LETTER (not header name), in this order. Defaults to all columns in a1_range.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: The id of the spreadsheet to inspect.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_ListSpreadsheetComments
tools.description: List a spreadsheet's comment threads, or the full replies of a single comment. In 'comments' mode each comment includes up to a few trimmed reply previews plus the total reply_count; use 'thread' mode for a comment's complete reply list. Without filters/ordering, pagination walks every comment. params.name: mode
params.description: 'comments' (default) lists top-level comments, each with a capped reply preview and a reply_count. 'thread' lists the FULL replies of one comment (set comment_id).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max comments (or replies, in thread mode) to return. Clamped to [1, 50].

params.name: order_by
params.description: Client-side ordering (comments mode) by created/modified time, ascending or descending. Defaults to Drive's native order.

params.name: resolved
params.description: Client-side filter (comments mode): keep only resolved (True) or unresolved (False) comments.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: Required when mode='thread': the comment whose replies to list.

params.name: max_length
params.description: Cap each returned comment/reply body (and quoted text) at this many characters. A longer body becomes '<prefix>…(+N chars)' (suffix not counted; N = hidden chars). Pass 0 for full, untruncated text; a

params.name: page_token
params.description: Opaque token from a previous call's page_token to fetch the next page.

params.name: comment_ids
params.description: Fetch exactly these comments by id (comments mode), instead of paging. Replaces a dedicated get tool. At most 50 ids per call, and not combined with page_token.

params.name: has_replies
params.description: Client-side filter (comments mode): keep only comments that have (True) or lack (False) replies.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Server-side filter: only comments modified at/after this RFC3339 time (e.g. '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Comments mode only.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: The id of the spreadsheet whose comments to list.

params.name: include_deleted
params.description: Include deleted comments/replies (their bodies are blank). Defaults to False.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_ReplyToComment
tools.description: Add a reply to an existing comment on a spreadsheet. To resolve or reopen the comment instead, use comment_on_spreadsheet with a status.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: The id of the comment to reply to.

params.name: reply_text
params.description: The text of the reply.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: The id of the spreadsheet the comment belongs to.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_ScanForDataIssues
tools.description: Deterministically flag 'weird'/bad cells in spreadsheet data. No LLM judgement: the same input always returns the same flags. Each cell-level finding carries a coord, a 0-based row_index/column_index (ready for a Sheets GridRange), the rule, a severity (high -> red, medium/low -> yellow), and a note-ready reason — so the output drops straight into an annotate/format recipe. In the default `mode='grouped'` these are aggregated per rule+column within each table into `groups` (with A1 `coords`); us

params.name: mode
params.description: 'grouped' (default) aggregates findings per rule+column within each table with counts; 'list' enumerates every flagged cell.

params.name: rules
params.description: Which deterministic checks to run. Omit to run every check. Each is fully reproducible (no LLM judgement).

params.name: a1_range
params.description: Single-sheet only: limit the analysis window (e.g. 'A1:F100'). Table detection still runs inside it; scope it to a single table's range for a precise scan. Defaults to the tab's used range.

params.name: max_rows
params.description: Max rows scanned per tab (applies to every scanned tab). Defaults to 200, floored to 1.

params.name: sheet_id
params.description: Scan only this tab (by numeric sheetId). Mutually exclusive with sheet_title. Omit both to scan every tab, grouped by sheet.

params.name: has_header
params.description: Treat each detected table's first row as labels (never flagged as a type outlier). Defaults to True.

params.name: orientation
params.description: 'columns' (default): records are rows, fields are columns. 'rows': the table is transposed — records are columns and fields are rows (row labels down column A). Applies to the whole scan, not per-tabl

params.name: sheet_title
params.description: Scan only this tab (by name). Mutually exclusive with sheet_id. Omit both to scan every tab.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.description: The id of the spreadsheet to scan. Scan one tab via sheet_id/sheet_title, or every tab when both are omitted.

params.name: max_items_per_group
params.description: Grouped mode: max cell coords listed per rule+column (within a table) before an 'omitted' count. Defaults to 10, hard-capped at 50.

params.name: treat_range_as_single_table
params.description: Single-sheet only: treat the whole a1_range as ONE table, skipping auto-detection. Use when detection would over-split a table that has an interior blank row. Defaults to False.

tools.name: GoogleSheets_SearchSpreadsheets
tools.description: Searches for spreadsheets in the user's Google Drive based on the titles and content and returns the title, ID, and URL for each matching spreadsheet. Does not return the content/data of the sheets in the spreadsheets - only the metadata. Excludes spreadsheets that are in the trash.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of spreadsheets to list. Defaults to 10. Max is 50

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort order. Defaults to listing the most recently modified spreadsheets first. If spreadsheet_contains or spreadsheet_not_contains is provided, then the order_by will be ignored.

params.name: pagination_token
params.description: The pagination token to continue a previous request

params.name: spreadsheet_contains
params.description: Keywords or phrases that must be in the spreadsheet title. Provide a list of keywords or phrases if needed.

params.name: include_shared_drives
params.description: Whether to include spreadsheets from shared drives. Defaults to False (searches only in the user's 'My Drive').

params.name: spreadsheet_not_contains
params.description: Keywords or phrases that must NOT be in the spreadsheet title. Provide a list of keywords or phrases if needed.

params.name: search_only_in_shared_drive_id
params.description: The ID of the shared drive to restrict the search to. If provided, the search will only return spreadsheets from this drive. Defaults to None, which searches across all drives.

params.name: include_organization_domain_spreadsheets

tools.name: GoogleSheets_WhoAmI
tools.description: Get comprehensive user profile and Google Sheets environment information. This tool provides detailed information about the authenticated user including their name, email, profile picture, Google Sheets access permissions, and other important profile details from Google services.
